contentHtml:
When the oven is busy with roast dinners and cookies, no bake christmas treats are a life saver. You still get cute and festive sweets, but without turning on the oven one more time. Perfect for last minute guests, parties, or when you are simply tired of baking.

In this guide I am sharing easy no bake christmas treats and no bake christmas desserts built around five simple recipes:

  • Chocolate cocoa truffles
  • Rice krispies Christmas trees
  • No bake Oreo cheesecake
  • Peanut butter chocolate bars
  • Yogurt parfaits with granola and fruit

You can make one or two of these no bake christmas treats for a small family, or prepare several and build a full dessert table.

Rich And Chocolatey No Bake Christmas Treats

These recipes are perfect if you love chocolate and want no bake christmas desserts that taste indulgent but are very easy to make.

Chocolate Cocoa Truffles

Chocolate cocoa truffles are small, rich bites that look fancy but are simple to prepare. You make a smooth chocolate mixture, chill it, roll into balls, then coat in cocoa powder, nuts, or sprinkles.

They are one of the best no bake christmas treats to put in small boxes or jars as edible gifts.

Why you will love them:

  • Only a handful of ingredients
  • No special equipment needed
  • Easy to flavor with vanilla, orange zest, or a splash of coffee

👉 Full recipe: Chocolate Cocoa Truffles

No Bake Oreo Cheesecake

No bake Oreo cheesecake is a creamy, crowd pleasing dessert that feels like a restaurant style treat. It usually has a crushed Oreo base, a smooth cream cheese filling with more Oreo pieces, and extra cookies on top.

If you want no bake christmas desserts that look like a full cake or can be made in small cups, this recipe is perfect.

Why you will love it:

  • No oven and no water bath needed
  • Easy to make the day before and chill overnight
  • Always popular with both kids and adults

👉 Full recipe: No Bake Oreo Cheesecake

Peanut Butter Chocolate Bars

Peanut butter chocolate bars are thick, sweet bars with a peanut butter layer and a chocolate top. You usually press the base into a pan, pour melted chocolate over, then chill until firm and slice into squares.

These bars are ideal if you want no bake christmas treats that are rich, sweet, and very satisfying.

Why you will love them:

  • Simple ingredients like peanut butter, butter, sugar, and chocolate
  • No baking trays or decorating skills required
  • Easy to cut into small pieces for sharing

👉 Full recipe: Peanut Butter Chocolate Bars

Fun And Festive No Bake Christmas Treats For Kids

These no bake christmas desserts are especially fun to make with children. They are colorful, playful, and perfect for holiday movie nights or parties.

Rice Krispies Christmas Trees

Rice krispies Christmas trees are made from marshmallow cereal mixture shaped like little trees, then decorated with sprinkles or candies. You can add green food coloring to make them look more like real trees.

Out of all the no bake christmas treats in this post, these are probably the cutest and most kid friendly.

Why you will love them:

  • No oven and very quick to set
  • Kids can help shape and decorate
  • Look great on a dessert table or snack board

👉 Full recipe: Rice Krispies Christmas Trees

Lighter No Bake Christmas Desserts

Not every holiday dessert has to be heavy. These no bake christmas desserts feel a bit lighter but are still festive and pretty.

Yogurt Parfaits With Granola And Fruit

Yogurt parfaits with granola and fruit are an easy way to serve something fresh among all the rich no bake christmas treats. Layer yogurt, granola, and colorful fruit such as berries, pomegranate seeds, or sliced kiwi in glasses or jars.

They work well as a light dessert after a big Christmas Eve meal, or even as a sweet breakfast or brunch option.

Why you will love them:

  • Simple to put together in a few minutes
  • Easy to customize for different tastes
  • Look elegant in clear glasses with visible layers

👉 Full recipe: Yogurt Parfaits With Granola And Fruit

How To Build A No Bake Christmas Dessert Table

You can use these recipes to create a whole table of no bake christmas treats without baking a single thing. Here are a few simple combinations.

Option 1: All chocolate lovers

  • Chocolate cocoa truffles
  • No bake Oreo cheesecake
  • Peanut butter chocolate bars

This selection is rich and indulgent, perfect for serious chocolate fans who love no bake christmas desserts.

Option 2: Kid friendly and fun

  • Rice krispies Christmas trees
  • Peanut butter chocolate bars
  • Yogurt parfaits with granola and fruit

This mix gives you playful shapes, something nutty and sweet, and a lighter option to balance it all.

Option 3: Light but festive

  • Yogurt parfaits with granola and fruit
  • Chocolate cocoa truffles
  • A simple plate of fresh fruit or store bought cookies

This option is great if you want no bake christmas treats that will not feel too heavy after a big dinner.

Tips For Stress Free No Bake Christmas Treats

To keep things easy, use these tips when making your no bake christmas desserts:

  • Plan fridge space:
    Many no bake christmas treats need chilling time, so make sure you have enough room in your fridge or a cool place.
  • Prep ahead:
    Truffles, bars, and Oreo cheesecake can usually be made the day before and kept chilled, which is perfect for busy Christmas Eve schedules.
  • Use nice glasses and plates:
    Simple recipes become impressive no bake christmas desserts when served in pretty jars, cups, or on a nice tray.
  • Mix textures:
    Combine creamy, crunchy, and chewy no bake christmas treats so your dessert table feels interesting and complete.

FAQs :

What sweet treats can you make without an oven?

Try no-bake desserts like cheesecake cups, chocolate truffles (or Oreo balls), peppermint bark, fridge fudge, pudding parfaits, chocolate-dipped pretzels, or a yogurt-and-berry parfait. These set in the fridge or come together with simple mixing and chilling.

What can I eat on Christmas without cooking?

You can build a no-cook spread with a charcuterie-style snack board (cheese, crackers, fruit, nuts), smoked salmon bagels, yogurt with granola, fresh fruit salad, store-bought pastries, and ready-to-serve desserts like cookies or chocolate. If you want something sweet, do berries with whipped cream or a quick no-bake cheesecake cup.

What sweet treats can I make quickly?

Fast sweet treats include chocolate bark, microwave fudge, no-bake cookie balls, brownies from a mix (if you decide to bake), fruit with honey and whipped cream, or dessert cups made with pudding and crushed cookies. Keep it quick by using store-bought whipped topping, pre-cut fruit, or melted chocolate chips.

What dessert can I make in 10 minutes?

A few great 10-minute options:
– No-bake cheesecake cups: cream cheese + powdered sugar + vanilla, topped with crumbs and berries
– Chocolate bark: melt chocolate, spread, add toppings (peppermint, nuts), then chill
– Parfaits: yogurt or pudding layered with granola/cookie crumbs and fruit
– Chocolate-dipped strawberries or pretzels: dip, sprinkle, and chill briefly
